title: oc-export configuration
description: Configuration schema for the oc-export CLI. The file is JSONC, so comments are allowed. Missing values fall back to the defaults shown below.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema that describes this file.

raw.description: Skip sanitization by default. When true, oc-export behaves as if --raw was passed unless --no-raw is used on the CLI.

extractor.description: Default session source. Valid values are 'opencode', 'claude', and 'pi'.

username.description: Display name used on the user-turn badge in exported HTML, rendered in uppercase via CSS.

picker.description: Options for the interactive session picker and --session lookups.

databasePath.description: Path to the local OpenCode SQLite database. The ~ prefix is expanded to the home directory.

limit.description: Number of recent sessions shown in the interactive picker.

claude.description: Options for the Claude Code source.

projectsPath.description: Path to the Claude Code projects directory. The ~ prefix is expanded to the home directory.

limit.description: Number of recent Claude sessions shown in the interactive picker. Defaults to picker.limit.

pi.description: Options for the Pi session source.

sessionsPath.description: Path to the Pi sessions directory. The ~ prefix is expanded to the home directory.

limit.description: Number of recent Pi sessions shown in the interactive picker. Defaults to picker.limit.

summarize.description: Options for replacing thinking and tool-call blocks with summaries via the llm CLI.

enabled.description: Master switch for the summarize feature. When false, --summarize is rejected and always is ignored.

model.description: Model ID passed to llm -m. Required when summarization is active.

always.description: When true, summarization runs by default without passing --summarize.

prompt.description: Custom system prompt used as a fallback for both thinking and tool-call summaries.

thinkingPrompt.description: Custom system prompt for thinking summaries. Takes precedence over prompt.

toolsPrompt.description: Custom system prompt for tool-call summaries. Takes precedence over prompt.

sessionSummary.description: Optional session-wide summary added at the top of the HTML.

enabled.description: Generate a top-level 'Session summary' panel at the start of the HTML after per-turn summaries are complete.

prompt.description: Custom system prompt for the session summary.

navigation.description: Bottom turn navigation bar shown in exported HTML.

enabled.description: Show the bottom turn navigation bar.

minTurns.description: Only show the bar when the session has at least this many turns. A value of 0 means the bar is always shown.

progressBar.description: Show a thin progress line at the top of the bar.

roleColor.description: Opt in to color pills by role: darker for user turns, lighter for assistant turns.
